Welcome to Race for Power, the ultimate test of speed and strategy! Train your heart out, hatch legendary companions, and leave your competition in the dust to become the fastest legend in the universe!

🎡 SPIN: Try your luck at the Daily Wheel for free boosts and secret rewards!

🐱 Pet System: Hundreds of pets to collect and trade.
